text:
12. 3. 5

Āsavakkhayasuttaṃ

3867. Jānato ahaṃ bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi. No ajānato no apassato. Kiñca bhikkhave, jānato kiṃpassato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti: idaṃ dukkhanti bhikkhave, jānato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti. Tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
